config.title: Wang Zhi 2023 recovery barge - HAMS/Cummins surrogate

platform.reference_point_note: The reduced model origin is the deck point vertically above the reported CG; x/y landing offsets are measured from that point.

mesh.note: The paper's AQWA mesh is not published. This HAMS mesh is regenerated from the published principal dimensions.

mooring.reason: The paper reports catenary layout and line length, but not line diameter, wet weight, EA, fairlead/anchor coordinates, or pre-tension.

plume_load.note: The 506-510 s Fp segment is approximated as the paper-stated 20400 kN plateau because Figure 6 is not supplied as numeric data.

model_notes.scope: Reproduces the Wang Zhi 2023 wave-plume-platform response chain as an open HAMS/Cummins surrogate.
model_notes.limits: The paper does not publish STAR-CCM+ load samples, AQWA mesh/project, second-order wave force data, or catenary line mechanical properties.

paper_assets.markdown_path: 海上平台火箭回收文献\海上火箭回收过程中船舶耦合运动响应分析_王智.md

unresolved.impact: 506-510 s Fp is a plateau from text, not the CFD oscillatory trace.
HAMS mesh is regenerated from principal dimensions and mass-matched trapezoid.
Current wave load uses HAMS first-order excitation only.
Mooring stiffness is not inserted because line EA, wet weight, anchor/fairlead geometry and pretension are absent.
